items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 24:1
items.html: These names, AVI, were renewed with the second restriction, for before that they were called Hochma and Bina. And the reason is what the Rav wrote above, Page 882, Item 32: that Hochma brought Bina out, in order to water the garden and to nurse him, who is ZA, because it is impossible for any Mochin to come into being for ZA until Ima goes out. See there. The explanation: ZON, from the aspect of their root in the ten Sefirot of direct light, were not fit for any Mochin, for ZA from his root is VAK, and the Nukva, from the aspect of the first restriction, is only the discernment of the concluding point and the quality of judgment. And had it remained so, there would have been no correction at all for this world, which came out in the discernment of empty void. And this is the secret of "at first the world was created with the quality of judgment; He saw that the world would not endure, so He associated with it the quality of mercy." For from the aspect of the first restriction no correction would have reached this world, as above; therefore the Malchut ascended to the place of Bina, which is the quality of mercy, and the two were associated together — both in the discernment of the coupling Malchut, which ascended to the openings of the eyes, which is the Bina of the head, and in the concluding Malchut, which ascended from the point of this world to the Bina of the body, which is the place of the Chazeh [chest]; and the TNHY of the Partzuf Nekudot of SAG of AK went out to the empty void, as above. And this correction is discerned such that the Hochma of the head, called the eyes, brought the Bina of the head — that is, the seven lower Sefirot of Bina, called the ear — outside the head, that is, to the discernment of the body. For the GAR of Bina took [it] for the discernment of its female, called the openings of the eyes. And by force of this, also the seven lower Sefirot of the Bina of the body, called the two lower thirds of Tifferet from the Chazeh downward, went out completely to the empty void, after the concluding point, as above. And this was in order to water the garden, which is ZON, because by this it became possible to draw Mochin to ZA and from ZA to the Nukva, as it is written, "He will drink from the brook by the way; therefore shall he lift up the head." And since Hochma and Bina were so diminished, for the sake of ZON, they acquired the names Abba and Ima, which are like a father and mother who do not look after themselves, but only to raise their children. Therefore the seven lower Sefirot of Bina, which are YESHSUT, are called by the name "the mother of the children", because she took upon herself this great diminishment of going out from the discernment of a head to a body, and from the discernment of Atzilut to the empty void, in order to raise the children, ZON, with Mochin. (Item 32).
